raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 27 duplicate txn_ids are restatements in raw_transactions: each pair has a record_version 1 and a record_version 2 row that differ only in amount, and the silver step keeps every copy. Keeping only the highest record_version per txn_id (applied before the POSTED filter) removes the duplicates and propagates the fix to all gold tables.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date, status, record_version, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
